summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Mahmoud el Karim, an Egyptian squash player who lived from 1916 to 1999. It states that he won the British Open men's title four consecutive times, from 1947 to 1950.
one_line: Egyptian squash player Mahmoud el Karim (1916–1999) who won the British Open men's title four straight times, 1947–1950.
key_facts: Mahmoud el Karim lived from 1916 to 1999.
Mahmoud el Karim was a squash player from Egypt.
Mahmoud el Karim won the British Open men's title four consecutive times.
Mahmoud el Karim's consecutive British Open men's titles were won from 1947 to 1950.
